summary_md: **Vishal Pandey ([@_vMyth](https://x.com/_vMyth/status/2116742028318986664))** shares **grip**, a git hook that quizzes you with five questions on your own diff and blocks the push below your team's pass mark; the offline demo only checks answer length, so use Claude Code or Codex for grading ([guilyx/grip](https://github.com/guilyx/grip)).
